referents.why: 'them' is the object of the piling: the dead frogs of Exo.8.9. The frogs are not among this verse's candidates, and none of the offered candidates is the frogs

the doer of the piling (masculine plural 'they') is unnamed, most likely the Egyptians gathering the dead; no candidate is a masculine plural people, and the nearest, houses and fields, are places, not doers

links.why: the land stank after the piling (cl0), not before; the link runs backward
The stench is what the piled dead frogs bring about. R4 gives an act and then what it becomes as result, not as then.
The stench is the outcome of the piling of the dead frogs: an act, then what it brings about.

none_fit.what: earlier non-person nouns (the frogs of Exo.8.9) are not offered as candidates, so a pronoun for them has no candidate to choose.

cant_tell.what: the referents of 'them' (w3) and of the unnamed doer of cl0
cant_tell.why: the frogs they pile are not among the candidates, and the subject is an impersonal third plural.
